Water is scarce in the place the Injes used to\nlive in. It won't rain for days and many times\nwe almost died because we ran out of water...
Now there's a lot of water here, but we can't\ndrink it because it's salty. It's tough for the\nInjes where there is Grecia.
There are many fish here. Sometimes we catch too\nmany and we can't finish them, so we dry them to\npreserve them, but they just don't get dry here.
Coming to a new place makes the children happy,\nbut many monsters from the sea would attack. It's\nvery dangerous so we need to watch them carefully.
[ffff64]Inje Village[ffffff]
You guys don't look familiar. This is\nInje Village. No outsiders are allowed here!\nGo away! If not, I'll make you pay the price!!
Inje? If I'm not mistaken...It's the ethnic\nminority that used to live in the desert and after\nthe cataclysm destroyed their dwellings,
they all went separate ways. That's what I heard\nthough...\nSo you've been living in this kind of place...
You illegal inhabitants! Let me convey the message\nfrom King Elbano IV to you! This is a holy place\nand no one is allowed to live here!
So leave this place immediately!\nIt's an order!!
Oh, no, no, hold it right there!\nDon't be so harsh and brusque!\nThat would just add fuel to the fire...
Oh my gosh!!
Help! The kids are being attacked by a monster!!
What?! Where are they now?!
The coast! The monster is drowning the kids!
Oh, the adventurer who fought alongside Grecia.\nI'm glad you came. Grecia was the goddess who\nsaved the Injes from the brink of death.
You were saved by Grecia and then you fought\ntogether.
You must have been sent here to talk about her.\nPlease, I want you to tell everyone about her...
Sir, this is a holy place for spirits to get\nto the Dark Realm.
Living here is not allowed. If it's being occupied\nfor a long time, more spirits will turn evil as\nthey can't go to the Dark Realm. Please leave now!
I can feel Grecia's presence here.\nWe won't move an inch before we see her!
You asked him if he knew anything...
If you go further, there is a Plateau called\nCelarra, and someone saw something like a ship\nlying at the bottom of the valley...
We've told you what you wanna know.\nNow it's your turn to tell us what we wanna know.\nThat's basic etiquette!
Phew...that was long~.\nWell, it's okay with us since we particularly knew\nwhat you were doing in the Dark Realm, but...
Your experience is unfathomable in the eyes of\nordinary people. Please share it with King Elbano\ntoo when you have time.
Hehe...You must be tired from talking\ncontinuously. Please get some rest.
I'll head to Celarra Plateau with the warriors and\nstart searching for the ark first.\nOff we go then...
T-t-t-that thing!\nThe thing that attacked you at the summit...\nA-a-aahhhhh!!
What happened? What surprised you?
T-t-that thing talked!!
I heard some screaming...\nWhat was it? Did you do anything dangerous?
Eh?
At the time the Injes started to gather here,\nthis thing fell down from the top of the cliff...
Aye!
S-seeing such a big thing with scary look fall\ndown must have surprised you, right?
Big and scary??\nThis thing fell down looking just like this.
Aye!
Eh?
This thing is obedient and he helps with various\nchores. That's why all the Injes here are looking\nafter him...
Ah right, the elder left a message for you.\nA room has been prepared for you.\nShe said you could use it if you want.
Aye?
Hmm...This thing seems to have lost his memories\nfrom the fall...Moreover, I wonder if he still\nremembers how to transform into a monster...
Well, forget it. Shall we just rest first in the\nroom they've prepared for us?
W-w-w-why are you following us?!
Aye! I wanna be with you, you seem fun!\nI'll follow you!
Hey, do you think...by looking at us his memories\nwould come back?
Also since he's actually a Coenubia, I wonder if\nhe would attack us again...
Regardless of whether he's a Coenubia, one thing\nfor sure is that he's not a creature from this\nworld. He may be an inhabitant of Toram.
In that case...\nLet's just keep an eye on him for a while.
Seriously?!\n...Hmm, well, perhaps he knows something about\nToram, but...
Alright, maybe he'll get bored too after following\nus for a while...Let's see how it goes then!!\nWhat's your name?
Aye? My name? I dunno.
What the, you even forgot your name?
Hmm, it'd be difficult to call you if you have no\nname...
Anono! Yeah, that's a nice name, isn't it?
From now on, you're Anono.\nRemember that, okay?
Aye! My name, Anono!
Hmm, it'd be better if you could speak a little\nmore fluently...Fine, I'll teach you after I put\nmy stuff down. Alright, let's go?
Aye! Morning, did you sleep well?\nThe weather is nice!
Huh? Mm-m-morning~...\nOoh, I was just teaching Anono some words at first\nand he picked up so fast.
Things got interesting and...\nI ended up teaching him all night...\n*yawn*
Aye! How is it? Quite impressive, right?\nHehehhe ♪
Somehow he seems to know a lot more now...
What?...I told you I'm fine.\nI'm feeling a little dizzy, but I should feel\nawake after walking a little bit...
Aight, let's get to where Reliza is...*yawn*
Ayyy! Wait for meeee!\nI'm going with you guys too!!
...I'm delighted to know that you all gather here\nbecause you admire me.
However, if you keep staying like this, the way\nto the Dark Realm will be blocked and the souls of\nthe dead may turn evil and begin to rage again.
To stop that from happening, would you please\nmove to another place?
We are able to meet you like this because we stay\nhere. We don't want to move!
Hey! The spirits couldn't go to the Dark Realm\nand became evil because you guys stayed here,\nyou know!
Stop being stubborn and giving Grecia a headache!!
Whoa, what a beautiful mirror!\nThe elegance and class of a god's creation is\nindeed on another level...
What?! There's no way I'm gonna steal such an\nimportant thing!!
It's not like I'll only show up here...\nAfter moving your people to another place, please\nput that mirror in the center of your settlement.
The mirror will tell me the location of the Injes\nand I'll try to pay a visit sometimes...
R-really?!\nEven if we leave this place, as long as we place\nthe mirror, you'll come to us?!
Fine! Guys, let's leave this place and find a new\nplace! It's a promise between the Injes and\nGrecia! We'll keep it for sure!!
Oh? Are you leaving?
Aye, I wanna hear more stories about this person!
Yes, because our duty to stop the spirits from\nturning evil and restore the way to the Dark Realm\nto its original state is done...
Besides, we've got tons of work waiting for us in\nthe Dark Realm. We have no time to laze around,\nso bye.
When we were purifying the evil spirits earlier,\nI sensed a different evil energy.\nMaybe it's still lurking around you...
Aye? What?
What about that little creature?\n...?! That little creature was the monster that\nattacked you?!
What?!
I am unable to read his mind, but I can't sense\nanything evil from him...The source of the energy\nseems to be somewhere else...
So, where is it coming from...?
I don't know...As soon as I return to the Dark\nRealm, I will examine it with Dunkelis and let you\nknow as soon as we find out about it...
Please just be careful...
What is it about??
